meta.title: APEX // Compute Collection 2026
meta.description: The premiere of 2026's flagship server hardware: AMD EPYC 9996 “Venice”, AMD EPYC 9965, Micron 512GB DDR5 RDIMM and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell.

hero.subtitle: Four flagships setting the bar for next-generation data centers: processors, memory and graphics — shown like exhibits in a dark gallery.

fallback.webgl: Your browser doesn’t support WebGL — showing a static view.

notFound.title: This exhibit isn’t in the gallery
notFound.body: The page is still being prepared or has moved.

chiplets.title: 8 chiplets. 32 cores in each.
chiplets.body: Beneath the lid: eight compute dies on TSMC’s 2 nm process and two I/O dies. Each one lights up with its own 32 cores.

generations.title: More cores. Nearly triple the cache.
generations.body: EPYC 9965 set the bar for density. Venice raises it on the new SP7 platform.

memory.body: DRAM dies are stacked and stitched together with through-silicon vias — TSVs. That is how half a terabyte fits on a single module.

gpu.body: Fifth-gen Tensor Cores with FP4 and 96 GB of ECC memory: large models, scenes and simulations fit entirely on one card.

assembly.title: Four flagships. One system.
assembly.body: The processor goes into the SP7 socket, memory into the slots, graphics into PCIe. Build your configuration and get a quote.
